materials.content: Pastel on paperboard mounted on paperboard

remarks_1999: Inscription in museum files: "Goats Horn with Red 1945/by Georgia O'Keeffe" [Andrew Droth, An American Place3, black ink]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946.... No signature." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Mrs. Watter is dead. The painting may be at Downtown Gallery again." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Pastel on paper laminated to cardboard', Hirshhorn refines medium listing as 'Pastel on paperboard mounted on paperboard'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden, 2026)

titles.title: Goat's Horn With Red

credit_line: Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden, Smithsonian Institution, Washington, DC, Gift of Joseph H. Hirshhorn, 1972
description: A goat's horn spirals in on itself, creating a large circle at the center of this semiabstract composition. The horn transitions from white at its base to bright red at its tip. The central circle of the composition is bright blue, while the outer area surrounding the horn is white.
materials: Pastel on paperboard mounted on paperboard
title: Goat's Horn With Red
